scope: Difficulty 0: 8 professions × 4 paired seeds = 64 runs; difficulty 3: 8 professions × 2 paired seeds = 32 runs; 96 full runs total.
method: Two-action greedy legal battle lookahead; paired deterministic seed strings within each version/difficulty; actual route rooms; rewards claimed using defaults; camp heal at HP <=24; when HP >24 and no shop has yet been visited this act, choose an available shop if holding at least the minimum 10-ember card price plus difficulty surcharge; buy an affordable evidence-supported card, preferring nonduplicates. Events choose an affordable evidence-supported card when available, preferring nonduplicates, otherwise trade for one when safe, else take ember gain/leave. CandidateFit v19 is used consistently for both v18 and v19 acquisition choices. JSON roundtrip after every action; public run wrapper used for all actions and checked against direct v18/v19 dispatch.
limitations: Small deterministic policy sample, not human-play balance evidence. CandidateFit evidence is a heuristic; the policy does not optimize long-term deck value, relic/item purchases, shop services, event pacts, or route choices. Runs stop at a 600-action bound.
